home.name: Charlie Tai
home.descriptionLead: Focusing on building high-performance web apps and robust backend services.
home.descriptionTail: Specializing in Angular, Vue 3, and Nuxt, expanding full-stack practice with NestJS and Docker.

section1.subtitle: Frontend Developer & UI/UX Enthusiast.

intro.title: From Passion to Profession
intro.content: Development is not just a job, it is my way of exploring problem-solving approaches. From self-learning to becoming a professional engineer, I enjoy the process of transforming complex logic into smooth user experiences.

techStack.title: Tech Background
techStack.content: Started with React, then moved to Angular for work, and later transitioned to the Vue ecosystem. Currently working primarily with Vue 3 and Nuxt, with Next.js for side projects. Also picked up Node.js (NestJS) and Docker along the way, which helps me communicate more smoothly across frontend and backend.

experience.title: Project Experience
experience.content: Mainly involved in frontend development for enterprise admin systems and conversational AI products, spanning key management, audit systems, and AI document recognition.

passion.title: Open Source Spirit & Continuous Improvement
passion.content: Committed to writing maintainable, highly reusable code. Develop side projects in spare time and publish common components to NPM, using open-source community standards to review and improve technical depth.

section1.quote: Make it work, make it right, make it fast.

list.description: Focused on frontend development for AI conversational products and enterprise management systems. Responsible for transforming complex AI logic into intuitive conversational interfaces and building scalable backend architectures.
Participated in the development of large-scale government pension systems, focusing on complex form logic processing and legacy system migration.
Served as the lead frontend developer, spanning e-book malls, government tenders, and system maintenance. Capable of maintaining multiple projects simultaneously and switching contexts quickly.
Established a solid foundation in web development through high-intensity training, covering HTML/CSS/JS core concepts and framework basics.

evolution.title: Want to know more?
evolution.content: Full experience, project details and technical depth — all in my resume.

portfolio.subtitle: A collection of my work & experiments.

systalk-adminhub.title: Systalk AdminHub
systalk-adminhub.description: In-house key management platform providing API Key management, access control, and usage analytics. Responsible for key configuration and security management for all TPIsoftware internal products to ensure secure inter-system communication.
features: Developed using the latest Angular version with Standalone Components architecture
Implemented complex key lifecycle management using Ngrx
Utilized RxJS for asynchronous operations to ensure clear data flow
Responsive design with TailwindCSS, supporting multiple screen sizes
Implemented tiered permission management system supporting multi-tenant key isolation
Provided key usage statistics and visual charts
Integrated ESLint + Prettier to ensure code quality and consistency
Docker containerized deployment for rapid scaling
Modular design for easy maintenance and extension
achievements: Established a complete key management system managing 100+ API Keys
Implemented fine-grained access control mechanisms to reduce security risks
Designed intuitive UI/UX enabling non-technical staff to operate easily
Established comprehensive error handling and logging mechanisms

systalk-audit.title: Systalk.Audit
systalk-audit.description: Internal audit system recording and tracking all critical operations within the system. Provides comprehensive audit logs, anomaly detection, and compliance reporting to ensure operational transparency and security.
features: Real-time monitoring of system operation logs with multi-dimensional query and filtering
Implemented interactive data visualization using Echarts to display audit trends
Managed complex filtering conditions and query states using Ngrx
Supported compliance report export (PDF/Excel) to meet regulatory requirements
Automated anomaly detection and alert mechanisms
Timeline view clearly presenting operation sequences
Role-based access control ensuring sensitive information security
Docker containerized deployment for easy maintenance and upgrades
achievements: Processed and displayed 100,000+ audit records while maintaining a smooth experience
Designed high-performance query mechanisms returning complex results within 1 second
Built a complete data visualization system enhancing data insights
Implemented flexible report export functions supporting multiple formats

systalk-global-life-icr.title: TransGlobe Life ICR POC
systalk-global-life-icr.description: AI intelligent document recognition system POC project integrating OCR and NLP technologies to automatically recognize and extract key information from insurance documents. Significantly improved claims review efficiency and reduced manual input errors.
features: Drag-and-drop file upload supporting batch processing
Real-time preview of OCR results with manual correction capability
Visual annotation system for marking key fields in documents
Integrated AI model API for automatic field classification
Supported multiple document formats (PDF/JPG/PNG)
Export and structuring of recognition results
Optimized loading states to enhance user experience
achievements: Successfully completed POC verification with 95% recognition accuracy
Reduced claims document processing time from 30 minutes to 3 minutes
Built an intuitive UI lowering system learning costs
Provided comprehensive error handling and feedback mechanisms

footer.tagline: Frontend Engineer · Crafting performant and interactive web experiences

roadmap.subtitle: From Frontend to Full-Stack · My growth plan
roadmap.intro: This map tracks my transition from frontend engineer to full-stack. Each goal pairs with a concrete deliverable — a project, a note, or an open-source contribution.

short.title: Short Term ｜ 1–3 months
short.description: Solidify core frameworks, fill the unit-testing gap, and ship backend CRUD.

mid.title: Mid Term ｜ 6 months
mid.description: Cloud deployment, containerization, CI/CD and auth in depth.

long.title: Long Term ｜ 1–2 years
long.description: System design, AI product development, startup or freelance full-stack.

nest-mastery.title: NestJS Backend in Practice
nest-mastery.description: Ship a deployable CRUD API with NestJS + PostgreSQL + TypeORM; master DI, Guards, Pipes and Interceptors.

vitest-coverage.title: Vitest Adoption
vitest-coverage.description: Bring Vitest + Testing Library into this portfolio; target 70%+ coverage on composables, mappers and critical UI.

nuxt-ssr-deep.title: Nuxt 3 Deep Dive
nuxt-ssr-deep.description: Get fluent with server routes, useFetch, middleware, SEO meta, and the static/SSR hybrid modes; publish sharable notes.

docker-compose-ops.title: Docker Compose Orchestration
docker-compose-ops.description: Stand up a Frontend + NestJS + Postgres + Redis + Traefik stack locally; nail healthchecks, volumes and networks.

aws-deploy.title: AWS Deployment
aws-deploy.description: Deploy the frontend with EC2 + S3 + CloudFront; learn IAM, Route53, ACM; evaluate Pulumi / Terraform IaC.

auth-oauth.title: OAuth 2.0 & JWT
auth-oauth.description: Integrate Google / GitHub OAuth; master refresh tokens, session management and PKCE; harden against CSRF / XSS.

system-design.title: System Design
system-design.description: Microservice boundaries, message queues (RabbitMQ / Kafka), event-driven architecture; own mid-sized system design decisions.

llm-integration.title: LLM & AI Agents
llm-integration.description: Go deeper into RAG, LangChain / LlamaIndex, multi-agent frameworks; ship a working AI product prototype.

fullstack-role.title: Become a Full-Stack Engineer
fullstack-role.description: Join a startup or freelance with full-stack + infra chops; lead at least one mid-sized product from zero to one.
